visualCharacteristics.purpose: a horizontal row of icon + label shortcut links (e.g. credit card categories)

contentPattern.structure: one row per item; cells: icon image (SVG) and a link whose text is the label (icon and link may share one cell)

usage: Category/shortcut link strips near the top of credit card product pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for 4-8 short icon links. Use the light option when the section is dark.
